scenes.title: Meet StudyScribe AI
scenes.caption: Record a lecture once. Get everything you need to study.
scenes.narration: Meet StudyScribe AI. Record a lecture once, and turn it into everything you need to study. Let's take a look.

scenes.title: Add a lecture your way
scenes.caption: Record live, upload a file, or paste a link. Transcription starts automatically.
scenes.narration: Start by adding a lecture. Record live in your browser, upload an audio or video file, or paste a link to a talk. Transcription starts automatically, in over twenty languages.

scenes.title: Accurate, timestamped transcripts
scenes.caption: Speaker labels on every turn. Click any timestamp to jump to that moment.
scenes.narration: In moments, you get a full transcript with speaker labels and timestamps. Click any timestamp to jump right to that moment in the audio.

scenes.title: Study notes in seconds
scenes.caption: Key concepts and summaries, generated from the transcript.
scenes.narration: One click gives you study notes, with the key concepts and summaries pulled straight from the transcript.

scenes.title: Flashcards, made for you
scenes.caption: Export to Quizlet, Anki or Notion, or start a review right here.
scenes.narration: Flashcards are created for you automatically. Export them to Quizlet, Anki, or Notion, or start reviewing right here.

scenes.title: Learn mode
scenes.caption: Start with recognition, then graduate to written recall.
scenes.narration: Learn mode starts with recognition, then graduates to written recall as your confidence grows.

scenes.title: Practice tests
scenes.caption: A mixed-format test built from your flashcards. Answers appear after you submit.
scenes.narration: When you're ready, take a practice test built from your flashcards. Answers are revealed only after you submit.

scenes.title: Practice quizzes
scenes.caption: Ten AI-written questions with instant scoring and explanations.
scenes.narration: Or take an A.I. written quiz, with ten questions, instant scoring, and explanations.

scenes.title: Study guides
scenes.caption: An overview, key concepts, and the details that matter.
scenes.narration: Study guides organize an overview, the key concepts, and the details that matter.

scenes.title: AI tutor
scenes.caption: Ask questions and get answers grounded in what was actually said.
scenes.narration: Stuck on something? Ask the A.I. tutor. Its answers are grounded in what was actually said in your lecture.

scenes.title: Emails and documents
scenes.caption: Turn a lecture into a summary email, a document, or a formal report.
scenes.narration: Turn any lecture into a summary email, a document, or a formal report, in the tone you choose.

scenes.title: Track your progress
scenes.caption: Recordings, transcripts, flashcards and quizzes at a glance.
scenes.narration: And keep track of your progress, with your recordings, transcripts, flashcards, and quizzes, all in one place.

scenes.title: StudyScribe AI
scenes.caption: Record once. Study smarter.
scenes.narration: StudyScribe AI. Record once, study smarter. Try it today.
